text: Wear a helmet to protect your head, choose your gear for speed and safety, and always stop when necessary. Helmets are essential for preventing head injuries in various activities such as biking, skiing, or skateboarding. In addition to helmets, selecting the appropriate gear, including protective eyewear and appropriate clothing, can significantly reduce the risk of injury. It is crucial to stop at every intersection, regardless of speed, to ensure your safety and the safety of others. By combining the right gear, careful navigation, and a commitment to safety, you can significantly minimize the risk of head injuries and enjoy your activities to the fullest.
summary: Wear a helmet to protect your head, choose your gear for speed and safety, and always stop when necessary.
